name: Mohamed Khaled Nordin
_note: M2 cohort expansion (key figures): Minister of Defence since the 12 Dec 2023 reshuffle. Objective spine plus a provisional Layer B pass on file; below ranking validity pending remaining objective dimensions and an independent Layer B panel. Layer B (Editorial Panel) is a SINGLE-CODER provisional first-coder pass (coderScores length 1): each score is recorded and cited but NOT scored, normalized, or ranked, per methodology.validity.minCodersToScore=3. Citations verified to exist via search; article full text was not opened (environment fetch restriction), so facts rest on cross-outlet-corroborated search summaries and require primary-source reconfirmation before any independent panel finalizes the score.

metrics.justification: No personal corruption charge or conviction of record. In the 2025-26 military-procurement corruption probe he is the responding minister, not a subject: the probe targets former army chiefs and vendor companies, not him. An earlier Johor-era allegation was never charged (he said the anti-corruption commission was "free to investigate"). Guilt by association is not recorded against the subject.

citation.title: Ex-Johor MB Khaled Nordin says MACC free to investigate him over Pasir Gudang

metrics.justification: Shapley-Shubik power index of the leader's coalition (Barisan Nasional) among the seven blocs of the 222-seat Dewan Rakyat (GE15, simple-majority quota 112), computed by scripts/compute-pivotality.mjs. BN (30 seats) holds the same index as PN (74 seats), 0.2214 — a textbook illustration that pivotal power is not seat count. Descriptive structural weight, not a merit score.

metrics.justification: Crisis handling when the military-procurement corruption scandal surfaced (late Dec 2025): he placed the Army Chief on administrative leave (announced ~27 Dec 2025) to prevent conflict of interest, pledged the ministry's full cooperation with the anti-corruption commission, and managed a procurement freeze to a documented close (12 May 2026). Decisive, dated action within remit (anchor 3).

citation.title: Army chief put on leave pending probe, says defence ministry

metrics.justification: The Littoral Combat Ship recovery showed material progress (first ship sailing 28 Jan 2026, sea trials from 28 Apr 2026) but slipped repeatedly against his own promised dates, with delivery pushed to late 2026; a defence-procurement anti-corruption overhaul announced 12 Jan 2026 is in rollout, not yet proven. Progress with dilution (anchor 2).

citation.title: Malaysia's First Littoral Combat Ship Begins Sea Trials

metrics.justification: Announced a Board for Strengthening Integrity and Trust within the ministry (12 Jan 2026) and pledged to work "shoulder to shoulder" with the anti-corruption commission (28 Jan 2026). A new internal oversight channel, but its independence and terms of reference are not yet verified, so credited conservatively (anchor 2).

citation.title: Defence ministry to set up independent integrity and trust board

metrics.justification: On the Norway naval-missile licence revocation (May 2026) he kept Malaysia's ~95% sunk payment and the cancellation on the public record and demanded compensation, criticising the "deafening silence". Candid disclosure of an externally-imposed reversal, but it was not his own policy reversal (anchor 2).

citation.title: Khaled: Norway apologised for cancelling missile deal but stands by decision
